question: 25% of the students are girls. If the number of girls is 200, find the total number of students.
explanation: Here, 25% of the students equals 200. | \[\Rightarrow 25\%\rightarrow200\] | To determine the value of 1%, divide 200 by 25. | \[\Rightarrow 1\%=\frac{200}{25}=8\] | Now multiply the value of 1% by 100 to get the whole. | \[\Rightarrow 100\%=8\times100=800\] | Therefore the total students is 800. | \[\Rightarrow \text{Total students}=800\]
